campaign_redirection.final_trial_reason: Actual closure routing exposes Rice prefix and indexed telemetry counters. Compare exact parallel rank/static counters; retain separately measured IDCT operand selection, scratch and scale cones as open obligations. The IDCT path is not the V104 dequantizer product-prefetch block.
campaign_redirection.last_trial_reason: Reject the over-packed fifth full-flow attempt and its strict-production-lint failure. Retain every failure; canonical tests of that rejected candidate are not run. The sixth candidate uses the separately clocked-tested shared-selector IDCT, matched unit-area preflight, exact24-bit suffix temporary projection, live ingress replay-count cache and all-offset scratch/head position predecode. Require strict fresh pipeline PASS before launching the last full flow; keep actual parent input-capture timing open.
campaign_redirection.pipeline_trial_reason: Parallel prefix factoring alone did not close the shared parser output path. Specialize SUFFIX extraction independently; prefetch actual IDCT operands within existing slots; cache the producer lookup coordinate at every original plane/tile transition. Preserve all public cycles and independently test before routing. No claim that prior path names remain final limiters.
campaign_redirection.reason: First LUT synthesis exposed serial scratch-plan sums; first LUT routing exposed full32 context division and Rice remaining-bit paths. Prioritize those measured violations to meet the fixed target.
campaign_redirection.scope: Deferred variants remain functionally tested, not natively measured. Initial runner declarations describe potential trials; this policy records the actual adaptive native campaign. All native runs keep full routing and 10ns constraints.
